messages:
Jun: heads-up — saw a 12-18% p50 latency regression for qwen-7b fp8 on the new microbatch steering + adaptive-kv prefetch path. Repro on staging with 2048 seq, packBatchSize=8. Profiling attached below.
Elaine: ugh. where exactly is the regression? batching, kernel select, or KV?
Jun: looks like a kernel-selection flip to a slower matmul on small heads at short sequence lengths. Also KV prefetch overlapping is lower (less overlap).
Sam: can you paste the perf counters? did kernel chooser fall back due to precision mismatch?
Jun: paste: ```
profile: qwen-7b | seq=2048 | microbatch=8 | fp8
kernel_choice: gemm_v2_slow (was gemm_v1_fast)
p50: 79ms -> 92ms (+16.5%)
cached_kv_hit_rate: 0.88 -> 0.72
kernel_time_breakdown: matmul 64ms (was 53ms), kv_copy 8ms (was 4ms), rest 12ms
fallback_reason: ropecosine_scale > 0.93 triggered headwise-kernel constraint
```
Marta: wait, "ropecosine_scale > 0.93"? That threshold was for fp8 stability right? Did the new RoPE scaling logic change thresholds?
Jun: Yes — new heuristic bumps effective RoPE scale for longer sequences to avoid underflow in fp8. But on qwen head dims (64/128 combos) that pushes kernel selector to the conservative path.
Tyler: can we try conservative RoPE scaling only for int variants and keep fp8 using the old threshold? Might avoid kernel flip.
Elaine: Also the microbatch steering reduces batch aggregation, so kernels optimized for larger packs don't get enough work and we fall to scalar-friendly kernels. Two orthogonal effects.
Sam: quick experiment suggestion: run with --kernel-force=gemm_v1_fast and measure p50/cost. Also run with kv_prefetch=off to isolate overlap impact.
Jun: I ran both: ```
cmd: ./run_profile --model=qwen-7b --seq=2048 --microbatch=8 --fp8 --kernel-force=gemm_v1_fast
result: p50=80ms (almost back to baseline), cost_tokens +2%
cmd: ./run_profile --model=qwen-7b --seq=2048 --microbatch=8 --fp8 --kv-prefetch=off
result: p50=90ms (partial improvement), cache_hit_rate 0.87
```
Marta: okay so kernel flip is dominant but prefetch overlap matters too. We need a longer-term fix in kernel selector to consider head/kv dims + RoPE scale simultaneously.
Tyler: another angle — AWQ vs GPTQ quant profiles differ in dynamic range; AWQ calibration sometimes reduces effective scale, could mitigate the RoPE threshold. Any quant family experiments?
Jun: I ran quick AWQ calibration prompts vs standard GPTQ: ```
quant=AWQ
calib_prompts: 200 random chat prompts + 50 long-context
accuracy_delta: -0.7% (LM eval) vs fp32
observed_scale: mean 0.91

quant=GPTQ
calib_prompts: default
accuracy_delta: -0.4%
observed_scale: mean 0.96
```
Jun: AWQ dropped observed RoPE scale which actually avoided the kernel flip but had slightly worse LM accuracy. So tradeoff.
Elaine: interesting. Maybe provide a model-profile flag that pins kernel selection for a model-quant pair, and surface warnings in Console when RoPE scaling will trigger conservative kernels.
Sam: agree. Short-term patch: in selector when head_dim <= 64 and fp8 and ropecosine_scale > 0.93, prefer gemm_v1_fast if microbatch_count >= 6. That heuristically recovers perf for our observed cases.
Tyler: add unit tests: matrix shapes that previously triggered gemm_v2_slow and assert selector picks fast path when pack size >= 6.
Marta: also add a telemetry tag for kernel_fallback_reason so we can roll out and measure impact across production traffic.
InfraBot: deployed patch candidate to canary cluster: canary-3. Config: selector tweak + telemetry.
Jun: thanks. follow-ups: 1) run full eval suite on AWQ vs GPTQ for qwen/mistral/mixtral family (focus head_dim buckets), 2) add Console alert when model-quant combo will flip kernels, 3) perf regression postmortem note if rollout shows >5% p50 increase.
Sam: I'll own the selector unit tests and canary dashboard. Jun, can you open the eval job and share artifacts?
Jun: opened job: https://ci.internal/runs/79312 (contains flamegraphs, perf counters, AWQ/GPTQ calibration artifacts).
Marta: tiny nit — when reporting these, include sample inference traces showing KV memcpy/compute overlay, e.g., timeline view. Helps infra triage.
Jun: will add. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
